stemMd: An object moves in a circle at constant speed. Which statement is correct?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It moves in a straight line at every scale.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Its displacement after a full revolution equals the circumference.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Its velocity changes because its direction changes.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Its acceleration is zero because speed is constant.

explanationMd: Velocity includes direction as well as speed. Uniform circular motion changes direction continuously and therefore has centripetal acceleration even with constant speed.

distractorRationale.b: Net displacement is zero after a full revolution.
